scenario: a routine everyday need involving health services & pharmacy
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Routine Everyday Need Involving Health Services and Pharmacy
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: health services & pharmacy — a routine everyday need involving health services & pharmacy
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a routine everyday need involving health services & pharmacy; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Thomas if she can get a flu vaccination.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi anh Thomas có thể tiêm vắc-xin cúm ở đây không.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Thomas. Can I get a flu vaccination here?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh Thomas. Tôi tiêm vắc-xin cúm ở đây được không?

turns.speaker: Mr Thomas
turns.vietnamese: Được chứ, mời chị đi lối này.

turns.speaker: Mr Thomas
turns.english: It will only take a minute.
